# Journal

## Iteration 1
Intent: Create initial capability from scratch.
- Added explicit rule against Excel formulas in prompt.md and task_template.md to fix Formula Use cluster.
- Added rule against writing Excel error strings and requirement to handle errors in Python to fix Excel Error Text cluster.
- Added "Precision & Minimal Change" rule to prevent over-modification of spreadsheets.
- Established a clear workflow (Inspect -> Plan -> Compute -> Write -> Verify -> Save) to improve reliability.
- Set explicit requirements for typed values (int, float, datetime) to prevent type mismatches.

Expected effect: Significant increase in score by eliminating the most common and systematic failures (formulas and over-modification).
Safe because: These are foundational constraints of the benchmark's grading system (literal values, no over-modification) and apply to all tasks.
